meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 集成微信个人号消息收发，无需付费Token
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将微信个人号接入自动化流程
copy.tagline_en: Integrate WeChat personal account messaging without paid tokens
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect WeChat personal account to automation workflows

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过你的个人微信账号接收和回复消息。使用腾讯官方 API，无需配置 webhook 或付费 token，通过二维码登录和长轮询实现实时通信。
howto.when: 当你向 Claude 发送“添加微信渠道”等请求时触发安装流程。安装完成后，当微信用户向 bot 账号发送消息时，Claude 会自动响应。

say.note: 启动安装流程，需手动执行后续步骤。

say.text: 连接我的微信账号到默认 agent 组。
say.note: 运行 wire-dm.ts 脚本完成连接。
让已连接的微信账号发消息，验证响应。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can receive and reply to messages via your personal WeChat account. It uses Tencent's official API, no webhook or paid token needed, with QR login and long-polling for real-time communication.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to add WeChat channel. After installation, Claude responds automatically when a WeChat user sends a message to the bot account.

say_en.note: Starts the installation flow, manual steps required.

say_en.text: Connect my WeChat account to the default agent group.
say_en.note: Runs the wire-dm.ts script to complete wiring.
Have the connected WeChat account send a message to verify response.
